description: Main source file for a synchronization demo using Zephyr RTOS, demonstrating thread creation, semaphores, and CPU pinning.

methods.name: hello_loop
methods.description: Main loop for threads to print greetings, synchronized via semaphores.

methods.name: thread_a_entry_point
methods.description: Entry point for dynamic thread A, initiates hello_loop.

methods.name: thread_b_entry_point
methods.description: Entry point for static thread B, initiates hello_loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that creates and starts thread A, optionally pins threads to CPUs.
